verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for TruffleHog, since its Enterprise offering holds findings in a hosted or self-hosted web UI. However, nothing in the evidence documents a way to export all data in open formats. Routing findings to Slack, Jira, email or webhooks is an adjacent notification feature, not a bulk export path for leaving the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
